title: P418 high-Re operating-combination independent fully coupled test
purpose: Repeat the six independent high-flow operating-combination trajectories with velocity, pressure, face flow and both temperatures evolving together.
source_title: Pore-scale simulation on flow and heat transfer characteristics in packed beds with internal heat sources at low Reynolds numbers
initial_state_rule: Use the source condition's completed steady-iteration-200 U, p, p_rgh, phi, fluid-temperature and solid-temperature fields. The label 200 is not physical seconds.
target_rule: At t=0 switch only the declared inlet velocity, inlet temperature or solid volumetric heat source to its exact P418 endpoint.
time_step_rule: Reuse the finest numerical schedule accepted by the representative fully coupled time-step study; the independent curves do not select a new schedule.
sequence_rule: Use the same six endpoint pairs as the fixed-hydrodynamics high-Re independent test.

model_use.evaluation_rule: Evaluate only frozen models selected from the original twelve-curve study.

scientific_scope: This separate set measures high-flow trajectory-combination transfer and the influence of full flow--heat coupling. It does not provide training data and introduces no new material, geometry, boundary or operating parameter.
